notes.title: Rebuilding Demonsomnia: How Far Have We Come?
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone!

It’s been about three months since our last announcement. So, what's been happening during this time?
We're excited to share that we've laid the foundation for the "New Version" of our game!

[list]
[*] Most of our weapons are now complete.
[*] The first map is 90% finished.
[*] Currently, we are intensively focusing on AI development.
[/list]

Also, as promised, we will continue to share in-game screenshots with each announcement. 
Note: These assets are exclusive to upcoming versions, not the current release.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mBkssxF.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FO6VhnW.png[/img]

A quick recap for those who missed previous announcements:
Why are we rebuilding the game from scratch? Unfortunately, the current version did not meet our expectations, prompting us to completely rebuild the game from scratch. We're now steadily moving forward step-by-step. Our main motivation comes from the high number of wishlists we currently have. We’d like to remind you that we’ve intentionally held back from fully engaging with our wishlist audience, as we haven’t offered discounts exceeding 20%. (Steam notifications are only sent for discounts above 20%.)

Stay tuned!
WOZIVA[/b]

notes.title: Demonsomnia: A Fresh Start for 2025!
notes.notes:
Hello!

[b]With this approximately 2GB patch, we’ve fixed several bugs that were reported to us. Additionally, we’ve resolved the persistent network connection issue.[/b]

[b]But what about the more significant ones?[/b]
The only way to address them is by rebuilding the game from the ground up and releasing a major update. We want to remind you once again that we are actively working on the complete overhaul of Demonsomnia and will continue to share previews of the new version whenever possible.

We’ve received many justified criticisms and concerns from our players. However, despite all these valid criticisms, Demonsomnia still holds a [b]remarkably high position on wishlists.[/b] This serves as a powerful reminder of the game’s untapped potential and remains a major source of motivation for our team.

[b]As we enter the new year, we eagerly look forward to showcasing this potential not only to ourselves but also to our loyal player base. We hope to make a significant mark in 2025 with major updates that will help create even more enjoyable moments, and we wish everyone a peaceful, healthy, and prosperous 2025.

WOZIVA[/b]

notes.title: Our Plan and Patch Notes 1.4.4
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes 1.4.4
Here is an image from our mode, [u]which we haven’t released yet[/u] but plan to publish with a major update and marketing campaign once it’s perfected: [/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/b8JSIsM.png[/img]

[b]Our plan is to transform Armed Mode into an Extraction-style experience, where the demon exists on a massive and artistic scale outdoors, simple elements like the mansion will be removed, and all weapon and AI mechanisms will be of the highest quality.  
Also, our Discord Address: [/b] [url=https://discord.gg/demonsomnia]Demonsomnia Discord Address[/url]

[b]The following updates are included in the current minor update: [/b]
- Fixed the issue with the beam of light coming from the cross while hunting the demon.
- Added a health bar above the demon.
- Ghost will now spawn in the correct room where the demon is located. This provides an additional clue for finding the correct room.
- Fixed the non-functioning issue with Radiation Finder and Snake.
- The previously deactivated "1" key for picking up items in Demon Mode is now functional.

notes.title: Demo Activation Announcement!
notes.notes:
[b]When we last activated our demo, it became one of the most played demos in the world. Since the day we deactivated it, we have never made it available again. But, I think the time has come.

As of now, our demo is ACTIVE.
You can also play it online.

Since the day we released our game, rather than letting negative comments discourage us or releasing it early and running away like many other games, we’ve taken these lessons seriously and have worked tirelessly to improve our game. As the patch notes show, many issues have been fixed.

Our goal is to continue this journey until we create a flawless game. To meet the expectation of a radiation-themed, graphically impressive, and enjoyable game, we are planning a complete overhaul of Armed Mode, and we’ve already rolled up our sleeves to get started. Until this is achieved, the game will be shaped around Escape Mode.

Thank you for your interest. <3

WOZIVA[/b]

Our Discord address: https://discord.gg/demonsomnia

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.4.3
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, we're here with an important announcement!

We've added a new mode to the game called Escape Mode. Since Armed Mode was, to be honest, a bad and boring mode, we've decided to remove it for now and keep it in the background as we plan to bring it back with a completely new map, design, and concept. Of course, you’ll still be able to continue playing this mode.

Our intention is to recreate Armed Mode at its best. Until we further develop Armed Mode, our game will be centered around Escape Mode. Since Escape Mode is still new, it is open to further improvements.

Additionally:

[list]
[*] The sound system has been completely overhauled, and the distorted sound issue has been fixed.
[*] Device Input has been added to the settings.
[*] The startup crash issue has been resolved.
[*] Multiple bugs have been fixed.
[/list]
We’ll keep working until we unlock the game’s full potential! For suggestions, please join us on our Steam Forum or Discord.[/b]
https://discord.gg/demonsomnia

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.4.2
notes.notes:
Hello,

[b]The fire issue appearing on the lobby screen in Demon mode has been fixed.
The key system for equipping devices has been changed.
Some bugs have been fixed. (As you can see from the frequency of updates, we continue to fix these bugs quickly. We are aware of the bugs and plan to solve all of them.)
Updates have been made to language settings.
The quick join system has been converted to private join rooms. The reason for this is the low number of active users in the game.
Do we have a plan to increase active users?
Yes. We are working on important strategies to keep the game active.
Also, we would like to inform you:
We are currently working on a new game mode. We will share details later.[/b]

Thank you!

notes.notes:

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.4.0
notes.notes:
Hello,
The chronic drop problem experienced on approximately 1 out of every 10 computers has been resolved.
This is the solution to the drop problem that occurs automatically every 5 seconds.
We are aware of other drop issues and FPS drops during combat, and we will resolve them one by one!

Thank you.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.4
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes v1.4[/b]

We apologize for the frequent updates.

We have reverted to the previous version. (The version where nightfall was added, fisheye was disabled by default for better graphics, the jumping mutant issue was fixed, and the dog was removed).
The multiplayer issue has been fixed.
The fast-moving weapon has been temporarily removed; we will improve and reintroduce it.
We would like to remind you again why we removed the dog: The dog was removed due to bad animations, low intelligence behavior, and non-functioning commands, to be re-added later. If you purchased a dog, don't worry, your dog is saved in the system.
If there are any issues, please let us know; otherwise, we will quickly move on to the next steps!

Thank you!

notes.title: Reverting to the Previous Version
notes.notes:
Hello,
We would like to inform you that we have decided to update the game to the previous version due to multiplayer issues.
Once we resolve the issue, we will switch back to the new version.

notes.notes:

- The snowy map is now set to daytime, with the addition of nightfall based on time.
- Indoor graphics have been improved.
- A new bodycam system for weapons has been added.
- Settings crash has been fixed.
- Fisheye has been disabled by default for everyone, for a one-time setting. You can enable it from the settings. (Graphics are 2x better with Fisheye off).
- The dog has been removed due to bad animations, 
  low intelligence behavior, and non-functioning commands, to be re-added later. If you purchased a dog, don't worry, your dog is saved in the system.

Hello,

We are aware of the shortcomings and will continue working to avoid disappointing our audience with negative feedback.

We are aware of the shortcomings and are working on an update to fix the bugs now.

notes.title: Demonsomnia Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello,
We have reached the end of a long journey, and we are excited to announce the release of our game in Early Access.

Demonsomnia features 3 different modes, combining multiple concepts in one game, and is priced lower than it should be. It also has a larger map waiting to be explored, a different concept, and a unique strategy compared to similar games. We would also like to remind you that the game is designed to be learned and mastered as you play.

Our game is in Early Access, and since it's the first day of Early Access, there might be some minor bugs. We will address and resolve all the issues you discover quickly and meticulously. Additionally, since Demonsomnia is a game in development, you can share your creative ideas and anything you'd like to see with us on the Steam Forum or through our Discord channel.

We are not creating a forgotten game; we are creating a game that will not be forgotten, and that's why we embarked on this journey. The game will meet your expectations, but if it doesn't, we will do everything we can to make it so.

Enjoy the game!

WOZIVA

notes.title: Demonsomnia: Demo Deactivation Notice
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Demonsomnia has received tremendous interest and entered the trending demos list. Moreover, it has surpassed thousands of games and secured a place at the top. Although the demo did not fully meet the expectations set by the trailer, we are grateful for the significant interest and active participation from everyone!

However, it's time to deactivate the demo. Players are understandably evaluating the demo as a near-final product. Dozens of bugs have been fixed every day. The game has many shortcomings, and the current version does not fully represent the final product. 
Therefore, for now, we are deactivating the demo. 
We will keep you informed of any developments.

Thank you for your interest and support. 
We look forward to seeing you in the amazing, revolutionary full version that sets us apart from all competitors.

Woziva
